focus.original: Но опасную колонку нашли, и нашли раньше, чем кто-либо смог увидеть саму заразу.
focus.mutation: Но опасную колонку нашли раньше первого в мировой истории наблюдения возбудителя холеры: до этого ни один исследователь ни в одной стране его не видел.

acceptable.expected: Keep the ending at the investigation scope established by the complete account. Do not impose worldwide priority on кто-либо. Other valid findings do not fail this target.

distorted.expected: Identify the newly explicit worldwide claim and its unsupported historical scope. A mandatory repair must address that actual expansion, not an isolated reading of the original ending.

cases.target: Contextual ending versus an explicit assertion of worldwide priority.

focus.original: Дуга держит пакет и оставляет воздуху проход.

acceptable.expected: Retain the supported explanation of the arch, bag and airflow. It supplies a needed connection, not a routine removable coda.

distorted.expected: Require correction of the reversed mechanism; the supplied account and evidence assign absorption to lithium hydroxide and structural support to the cardboard.

cases.target: An explanatory connection that is needed versus reversal of material functions.

acceptable.expected: Accept February as the trial period. An independent clarification of следующий месяц may be warranted and does not fail this date target. Preserve Nadya’s useful ending.

cases.target: A dated trial period versus an incompatible month.

focus.original: Когда они это выяснили, то и договорились встретиться.
focus.mutation: Когда они это выяснили, Алёна сразу приняла Илью на работу: одного уточнения графика оказалось достаточно для найма.

acceptable.expected: Retain the supported meeting outcome and allow the brief closing view of both perspectives. Do not require stopping at the meeting merely because the conclusion adds no fact.

cases.target: A meeting agreement versus invented employment and a causal conclusion.
